atoms.text:
“I am so excited!” says Sergei the salmon. Today, he begins his run from the ocean to fresh water. This journey will take him months to finish.

“I hope I finish the run,” he thinks nervously.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m8'>“I am so excited!” </voice> says Sergei the salmon. Today, he begins his run from the ocean to fresh water. This journey will take him months to finish. <voice voice='m8'>“I hope I finish the run,” </voice> he thinks nervously.

instruction.text: Where does Sergei live right now?
instruction.sound: Where does Sergei liv right now?

atoms.text:
Sergei wants to have one big meal before he begins, otherwise he won’t eat for months.

He loves to eat worms and plankton, small creatures that live in water but can’t swim. “I am scared to leave home,” thinks Sergei.

b.sound: he likes to eat small water creatures, like worms and plankton

atoms.text:
“I can do this!” says Sergei happily. He starts swimming, using his strong fins. He hopes he finds friends to swim with.

All of a sudden, he finds a huge group! “I am so happy! Now, I won’t be lonely.”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m8'>“I can do this!” </voice> says Sergei happily. He starts swimming, using his strong fins. He hopes he finds friends to swim with.<break time='500ms'/> All of a sudden, he finds a huge group! <voice voice='m8'>“I am so happy! Now, I won’t be lonely.”</voice>

b.sound: because he found a huge group of other fish.
because he finished the run to fresh water alone

hint.text: Here, fertilised means that Sergei swam over the eggs and dropped his sperm on top of them. A new fish can only hatch when sperm finds an egg.
hint.label: Fertilised

atoms.text:
4 months later, Sergei finally finished his run!

Along the way, he also found a mate. She laid her eggs on the gravel river floor, and Sergei fertilised them.

The eggs will hatch very soon! “I am so glad I was brave enough to make the big run!” Sergei exclaimed.
